text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
FlyFrom(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan FliesTo(Susan, LGA) ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
¬(DepartureAirport(Susan) = ArrivalAirport(Susan)) ::: The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport for Susan.
FlyFrom(John, LGA) ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
FliesTo(John, LGA) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
